context: The solution must import and use the StepTracker class from specify-cli to manage multi-step progress state and render output. Evaluation focuses on correct use of the class's add, start, complete, error, skip, and render methods. Internal implementation details beyond these methods are not assessed.

checklist.name: StepTracker import
checklist.description: Imports `StepTracker` from the `specify` package (e.g. `from specify import StepTracker` or equivalent) rather than reimplementing the class.

checklist.name: add and start
checklist.description: Calls the tracker's `add` method to register steps and its `start` method to transition a step to the in-progress state.

checklist.name: complete method
checklist.description: Calls the tracker's `complete` method on a step and verifies the rendered output reflects the completed state.

checklist.name: error method
checklist.description: Calls the tracker's `error` method with an error message and verifies the rendered output includes the error state and message.

checklist.name: skip method
checklist.description: Calls the tracker's `skip` method on a step and verifies the rendered output reflects the skipped state.

checklist.name: render output
checklist.description: Calls the tracker's `render` method (or equivalent) to obtain the full state string and asserts it contains the correct status indicators for all steps.
